title: Frosted Privacy Window Film Ticino, Switzerland | VAM Deco
description: Frosted and opaque privacy window film in Ticino, Switzerland: instant privacy without losing natural light, for offices, shops and homes. Free quote in 24/48h.
h1: Frosted and opaque privacy window film in Ticino
heroParagrafi: Want more privacy in your office, home or shop without curtains or walls? Frosted window film turns glass and glazing into elegant, private surfaces that still let natural light in and enhance the style of your spaces.

Across Ticino, from Bellinzona to Locarno, Lugano and Biasca, we install opaque and frosted window films, ideal for anyone who wants to shield their spaces from prying eyes without giving up brightness.
Perfect for offices, professional practices, shops and private homes, they create modern, secure spaces with a refined, long-lasting result.
claimArancione: Fast installation, with the option to customise the glass with logos, lettering or decorative patterns.

beneficiTitolo: Need privacy, comfort and security for your spaces in Ticino?
beneficiIntro: With our frosted and opaque window films you get instant privacy and elegance, without losing natural light. A simple, fast and long-lasting solution, ideal for offices, practices, businesses and homes.

benefici.testo: Frosted films make glass opaque to outside view: instant privacy for offices, medical practices, meeting rooms, bathrooms and shop windows across Ticino.
Opaque film blocks the view but lets natural light through: rooms stay bright and welcoming, with no compromise on privacy.
Do away with heavy curtains and blinds: frosted film delivers privacy on the glass with a modern, minimalist look that is easy to clean.
We customise window films with tailor-made logos, lettering and decorative patterns, to enhance the image of your business or your home.
The film is applied directly onto the existing glass: no building work, no dust, quick application and an immediate result, even in fully furnished rooms.
The uniform frosted or etched effect gives the glass a refined, professional look that blends in with any decor in an office, shop or home.

fasi.d: Together we work out where you want more privacy (office, bathroom, shop window) and, on request, we carry out a free, no-obligation site visit to recommend the best solution for you.
We prepare a free quote and show you examples and the films available, including custom options.
In just a few minutes the film is applied with no dust, noise or invasive work. It can be removed later without any damage.
Right after application you will have opaque, elegant and private glass. More natural light, fewer prying eyes.

faq.domanda: What does "frosted / privacy window film" mean?
faq.risposta: It is a type of film applied to the glass that makes the surface opaque while still letting natural light through. It protects rooms from outside view, keeping them bright and elegant.

faq.domanda: How much does frosted window film cost?
faq.risposta: Every project is tailor-made: the size of the glass, the type of room and details such as handles or hinges all change the work involved. That is why the quote is free and, on request, we carry out a no-obligation site visit.

faq.domanda: How long does frosted film last? Does it wear out over time?
faq.risposta: When applied correctly by professionals and looked after properly, it can last many years without deteriorating. Just avoid scratching it with sharp objects and harsh cleaning.

faq.domanda: Can the film be removed without damaging the glass?
faq.risposta: Yes. Frosted film can be removed without leaving any damage on the glass when the installation has been done properly. It is a reversible, flexible solution.

faq.domanda: Can I customise the film (logo, lettering, patterns)?
faq.risposta: Absolutely. We offer personalisation options for every need: company logo, decorative lettering, patterns on the glass. Perfect for offices, shops and professional practices.

faq.domanda: Where is opaque privacy film most useful?
faq.risposta: Offices (meeting rooms, privacy booths), homes (bathrooms, internal doors, balconies and verandas), shops with display windows, professional practices and healthcare settings.

perchePara: In-house production in Sementina, a single point of contact from idea to delivery, and the same care whether it is a single bathroom pane or the glazing of an entire office.
